title: Phosphor Field
summary: A phosphor-inspired dark theme with mint traces, lime energy, and a deep instrument-green workspace.
descriptionMarkdown: Phosphor Field reimagines PLVS as a modern measurement instrument built around luminous green displays. Mint secondary traces, lime primary data, and a restrained coral overload state remain readable against the deep green-black workspace. Its level meter, waveform, spectrum, and intensity map share one coherent phosphor language without collapsing into monochrome.
